master.title: M-04F master: epistemic jurisdiction, burden allocation, and counterfactual foreclosure
master.purpose: Operate the thirteen decisive lanes without converting structural asymmetry into motive, wrongdoing, coercion, extraction, or one coordinated class monopoly.
master.stopping_rule: The program closes only when every lane has a terminal disposition and the cross-system proposition has been supported for named human review, bounded, or falsified.

lanes.title: DCGS positive control: complete the preventive burden-shift record
lanes.question: Did the judicial intervention materially change the gate, burden, option set, and final acquisition path?
lanes.falsifier: The post-judgment acquisition proceeded without material gate change or the later award was wholly independent.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when the burden shift, option set, causal limit, and comparator record are terminally adjudicated.

lanes.title: Army enterprise: test continuity thresholds against observed exit
lanes.question: Were continuity, migration, rebuilding, and reaccreditation thresholds independently validated against an operated alternative?
lanes.falsifier: Observed replacement or phased substitution is rapid, proportionate, and mission-preserving.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when every continuity assertion has a source, comparator, observed test, and terminal disposition.

lanes.title: NGC2: reconstruct target confidence, human veto, and abort
lanes.question: What information, confidence, time, and authority did soldiers and commanders possess before target-to-effect action?
lanes.falsifier: The stack did not materially inform the effect or human operators possessed no meaningful veto.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close after one full target-to-effect trace and a matched legacy or alternate-system comparator.

lanes.title: NGC2: freeze component denominator and common-baseline alternatives
lanes.question: Did competition remain real at the common data baseline and critical-component level after program-level awards?
lanes.falsifier: Common components were competitively replaceable and alternatives generated comparable operating evidence.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when program and component counterfactuals are separately adjudicated.

lanes.title: ImmigrationOS: acquire one person-level inference-to-consequence file
lanes.question: Did system data or prioritization materially shape one apprehension, detention, departure, removal, or nonaction, and could the person stop or correct it?
lanes.falsifier: Complete cases show the system supplied no material inference or effective pre-action review prevented erroneous consequence.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close only with a complete causal chain or an explicit bounded non-link.

lanes.title: ICE: map source-to-system evidence custody and interfaces
lanes.question: Who can reconstruct the complete enforcement decision across source systems, ICM, ImmigrationOS, users, supervisors, and review bodies?
lanes.falsifier: ICE independently holds and can disclose a complete, versioned, auditable chain.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when every decisive field, transformation, user action, and custodian is mapped.

lanes.title: NHS: test patient standing and use-case governance
lanes.question: Can a patient or service user contest the category, purpose, or action before consequence, not merely correct data afterward?
lanes.falsifier: No consequential patient-facing action exists or effective pre-action standing is demonstrated.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close with one complete use-case and subject-standing file.

lanes.title: NHS: observe migration and practical substitution
lanes.question: Did an alternate supplier actually assume data, product, workflow, users, accreditation, and operating responsibility with continuity and proportionate cost?
lanes.falsifier: The alternative completed effective operation with no material incumbent dependency.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when the product-level and enterprise-level exit propositions are separately terminal.

lanes.title: Brave1: build validation, failure, error, and benefit ledger
lanes.question: Who sets validation thresholds, who bears failed-model or battlefield error, and who receives the resulting data, orders, IP, and standards position?
lanes.falsifier: Benefits and errors are proportionately allocated with effective preventive stopping authority.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close after positive and negative validation paths are both represented.

lanes.title: Erebor: resolve regulatory thresholds, investor rights, and matched comparators
lanes.question: Were Erebor conditions, capitalization, investor rights, and post-opening financing ordinary relative to matched de novo banks?
required_objects: matched de novo approvals and failures
lanes.falsifier: Matched controls show ordinary treatment, rights, capital, customer mix, and outcomes.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when public gate, private rights, operating traffic, and comparators are reconciled.

lanes.title: Palantir Ontology: map category authorship, action rights, and subject standing
lanes.question: Who defines the actionable objects and actions in one deployment, and can represented people reject the schema or stop the action?
lanes.falsifier: The deployment contains no consequential ontology-mediated action or represented people possess effective authority over category and action.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close with one deployment-specific constitutional chain.

lanes.title: Palantir governance: test founder counterfactual and succession
lanes.question: What alternative corporate constitution, succession, or shareholder correction can produce evidence under the founder structure?
lanes.falsifier: Independent directors or ordinary shareholders routinely alter purpose or control despite the founder structure.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close when formal rights and observed governance outcomes are reconciled.

lanes.title: Pattern-to-proof: preserve the human signal and adjudicate cross-system uncertainty allocation
lanes.question: How should an early human pattern signal become a rigorous acquisition program without being dismissed for missing receipts or promoted beyond evidence?
lanes.falsifier: The early pattern dissolves after factual correction or the cross-system asymmetry is explained by ordinary independent institutions without repeated rights-holder concentration.
lanes.stopping_rule: Close only when the seed claims, corrections, surviving mechanism, and cross-system distributions are explicitly versioned.
